objective: Choose a profitable operating size through predictions, observed runs and explicit comparisons; distinguish coordination-driven rising costs from bottlenecks and underused capacity, and transfer the method to a different business.

weeks.idea: Fixed cost spread over more units

weeks.evidence_gate: At least three press counts including smaller and larger balanced fully used setups with higher unit cost than the best run; learner selects the actual best balanced run and larger comparison run.

weeks.idea: Idle capacity; optimal size follows demand

taxonomy_coverage.claim: Use displayed revenue, total cost and profit for runs the learner chose to select a profitable configuration; profit is computed by the game, not unaided.
Recognise loss-making days (costs above revenue) and respond by changing the configuration; no free-text explanation is graded.

authored_extensions: Coordination cost growing with pairs of teams
Comparison of balanced fully used configurations, distinguished from bottlenecks and underused capacity
Idle capacity and demand-dependent optimal size
assumed_prerequisites: Distinguishing a day's total from a per-unit amount
prerequisite_mastery: Unknown; inspect the saved generated plan. The source topic's age 7–9 band is a foundation, not the requested audience level.
not_assessed: Marginal cost, short- versus long-run cost curves by name
Bulk purchasing discounts and supplier bargaining

tool_decisions.threejs: Print-studio floor with pallets flowing through presses and curing tunnels, a stuck pile at the bottleneck, sync cables between every pair of teams, a segmented cost bar with a revenue flag, and direct scene picking to add, remove and run.
tool_decisions.gsap: Deterministic replay of an already-computed day and a win pulse; cancelled on seek and skipped under reduced motion.
tool_decisions.html_svg: Accessible setup controls, pre-run predictions, selected evidence pair, result summaries and an experiment scatter plot with full run details. Phone flow keeps results and the next task together; detailed records remain expandable.

design_review: Initial Press Club direction by Fable; subsequent Codex review identified missing turning-point evidence, predictable answer positions, cosmetic cash, confounded chart points and mobile scrolling. Sol 6.1 agents implemented model/UI revisions with parent integration review; see design-brief.md and AGENTS.md. No new Astra or Terra consultation.
source_review: Local exact taxonomy evidence, local Munger scale research and the disclosed fictional equations. No external economics source retrieved.

prediction_protocol.when: Before running a changed setup after an earlier observation
prediction_protocol.response: Predict lower, same or higher average cost against the named prior run
prediction_protocol.record: Bind the prediction to its setup and reference run; preserve predicted and actual direction with feedback. Incorrect predictions do not block further learning.

experiment_allowance: Six resettable test days per training round. Results persist across retries. Success evaluates a prospective operating plan; cumulative cash and financial solvency are not simulated.
